buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder's Average Annual Turnover: The bidder must have an Average Annual Turnover of at least ₹ 50 Lakh during the three consecutive financial years FY 2022–23, FY 2023–24, and FY 2024–25. The turnov er certificate must be duly certified by a Chartered Accountant (CA) and must contain a valid UDIN. 2. GST Documents: The bidder must submit a valid GST Registration Certificate along with GSTR returns for the period from June 2026 to August 2026. 3. Audited Financial Statements and ITR: The bidder must submit audited financial statements for FY 2022–23, FY 2023–24, and FY 2024–25, along with the corresponding Income Tax Return (ITR) acknowledg ements. 4. OEM Average Annual Turnover: The OEM must have an Average Annual Turnover of at least ₹4 Cror e during the three consecutive financial years FY 2022–23, FY 2023–24, and FY 2024–25. The turnover certi ficate must be duly certified by a Chartered Accountant (CA) and must contain a valid UDIN. 5. OEM Authorization (MAF) : In case of a reseller, the bidder must submit a valid OEM Authorization Le tter (MAF) in its favour, containing verifiable OEM details, including name, designation, address, email ID, and telephone number. 6. Non-Blacklisting Undertaking: The bidder must submit an undertaking on ₹100 non-judicial stamp p aper declaring that it has not been blacklisted or debarred by the tender-inviting authority, any State or C

entral Government, or any Government of India organization, and that no such blacklisting or debarment is in force as on the bid submission due date. The bidder must also undertake to supply the items in accorda nce with the specifications mentioned in the bid. 7. Technical Specification Compliance: The bidder must submit a Technical Specification Compliance S heet on the OEM's letterhead, duly signed and stamped by the authorized representative. 8. Warranty Certificate: The bidder must submit a valid Warranty Certificate for the offered product alo ng with the bid. 9. Product Data Sheets: Detailed technical data sheets of the offered product must be uploaded with th e bid, duly marked, signed, and stamped. All technical parameters must correspond to the offered configur ation. Any mismatch may result in rejection of the bid. 10. Price Inclusiveness Undertaking: The quoted price must include all applicable taxes and charges, i ncluding delivery, installation, testing, commissioning, and training, wherever applicable. The bidder must submit an undertaking on the bidder's or OEM's letterhead, duly signed by the authorized representative, confirming the same. 11. Service Centre: The bidder must have a functional service centre in the State where the consignee is located. Documentary evidence confirming the existence of the service centre must be submitted along wi th the bid. 12. Service Escalation Matrix: The bidder or OEM must submit a service escalation matrix containing te lephone numbers and contact details of the designated service support personnel. 13. Trademark Registration: The bidder must submit a valid Trademark Registration Certificate for the offered brand. 14. Past Supply Experience: The bidder must have supplied the same product to a Government Depart ment with a minimum cumulative supply value of ₹50 lakh. Copies of relevant Purchase Orders and supply /performance certificates must be submitted as documentary evidence. 15. Laboratory Test Report: The bidder must submit a valid Laboratory Test Report for the offered prod uct along with the bid. 16. ISO Certifications: The bidder must submit valid certificates for the following standards: a. ISO 14001:2015 b. ISO 45001:2018 c. ISO 50001:2018 d. ISO 9001:2015 e. ISO 10002:2018 f. ISO 15189:2024 g. ISO 14732:2012 17. RoHS Compliance Certificate: The bidder /OEM must submit a valid RoHS Compliance Certificate for the offered product. 19. Solvency Certificate: The bidder /OEM must submit a valid Solvency Certificate issued by a compete nt authority or an authorized financial institution. 20. ZED Certification: The bidder/OEM must submit a valid Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) Certification. 21. GMP Certification: The bidder/OEM must submit a valid Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Certific ate, wherever applicable. 22. Green Guard Certificate: The bidder/OEM must submit a valid Green Guard Certificate for the offere d product, wherever applicable. 23. CE Certification: The bidder must submit a valid CE Certificate for the offered product, wherever app licable. 24. Document Submission Restriction: No fresh or additional documents shall be accepted from a bid der after technical disqualification. 25. OEM Manufacturing Experience: The OEM must have more than five years of experience in manufa cturing the quoted item. Documentary evidence confirming the manufacturing experience must be submitt

ed along with the bid. 26. Character Certificate : A bidder must submit valid character certificate of Proprietor/Partner/Director of the firm. 27. District wise Delivery : Bidder has to ensure district wise delivery in all the 38 districts across the Bi har State. List of 130 locations will be shared with L1 bidder. 28. Warranty : Bidder has to ensure onsite warranty at all the 38 districts across the Bihar State. .
